start.title: シナルの平野
start.text:
広々とした緑の平野が目の前に広がっています。
全人類がここに集まりました。一つの民、一つの言葉です。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:2 — The people settled in the plain of Shinar and dreamed of greatness.

unity.title: 一つの言葉
unity.text:
声が溶け合い、笑い声が響きます。
理解できない言葉は一つもありません。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:4 — They said, 'Let us make a name for ourselves.'

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: 壮大な計画
proposal.text:
一人の長老が立ち上がります。「天に届く塔を建てようではないか。」
「我々の名を轟かせようではないか。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:3-4 — The people joined together to build a city and a great tower.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: レンガとアスファルト
bricks.text:
あなたは湿った粘土をレンガに成形します。
それらは石よりも強く、空に届くでしょう。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:3 — They made bricks and used tar for mortar to build the tower.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: 最初の階層
construction.text:
壁が立ち上がります。塔は長い影を落とします。
男たちは梁を持ち上げながら歌います。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:4 — They boasted, seeking a tower with its top reaching the heavens.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: さらに高く
rising.text:
年が過ぎ、石が積み重ねられます。
塔は雲を突き抜けます。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:4-5 — The tower rose higher in pride until the Lord came down to see it.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: 空に触れる
summit.text:
あなたは頂上に立っています。下界の地球は小さく見えます。
天は近く、ほとんど手の届くところに感じられます。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:4 — Their pride reached upward, seeking to make a name for themselves.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: 主が降りて来られる
gods_gaze.text:
雷鳴のように穏やかな声が空に満ちます。
「彼らは一つの民である。彼らにとって不可能なことは何もないだろう。」

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:6-7 — God saw their pride and chose to confuse their language.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: 奇妙な言葉
confusion.text:
あなたは友に叫びます。彼はじっと見つめます。
彼の口が開きますが、その音は意味をなしません。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:7 — God confused their language so they could not understand one another.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: 出発
scattering.text:
家族は持てるものを集めます。
それぞれのグループが異なる地平線に向かって歩き出します。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 11:8 — The Lord scattered the people from there over all the earth.

reflection.title: 新しい土地
reflection.text:
あなたは静かな尾根で立ち止まります。
塔ははるか後方、傲慢の記憶です。
